class.name: VMLModLoader
class.brief_description:
VortarisModLoader engine singleton (`VML`): namespaced id registry, unified content database, declarative hooks, runtime mod lifecycle.
VortarisModLoader 引擎单例（`VML`）：命名空间 id 注册表、统一内容数据库、声明式钩子、运行时 mod 生命周期。
class.description:
Registered at engine start (SCENE level) before any autoload; exposed to scripts as the `VML` singleton.
[b]Content model[/b] — every piece of moddable content is addressed by a dotted, namespaced id `namespace.path` (e.g. `game:units.knight`). Mods stack above the base layer; a later-loaded mod wins when two providers claim the same id. Override arbitration is deterministic: priority, then explicit flag, then mod id.
[b]Three layers:[/b] - [b]Routing[/b]: id → winning physical file ([method has], [method resolve], [method get_data], [method get_resource], [method instantiate]). - [b]Database[/b]: an in-memory repository that can preload every data id for O(1) lookups ([method preload_database], [method get_all], [method set_data], [method delete_data]). - [b]Hooks[/b]: declarative event points, each a namespaced id ([method add_hook], [method invoke_hook], [method emit_hook], [method check_hook]).
Mods are discovered under `res://mods` and `res://mods-unpacked/` (default [member get_mod_roots]); `.pck` packs under a root are mounted read-only and their content indexed (content must be namespaced under `mods/<mod_id>/`). Enable/disable/load/unload at runtime with [method enable_mod]/[method disable_mod]; [method install_mod_from_zip] extracts a zip mod into the first writable root (dev only — distribution uses packs).
在引擎启动时（SCENE 层级，早于任何 autoload）注册，脚本中以 `VML` 单例访问。
[b]内容模型[/b] —— 每个可 mod 内容用点分隔的命名空间 id 寻址（如 `game:units.knight`）。mod 堆叠在基础层之上；多个提供者声明同一 id 时，后加载的 mod 胜出。覆盖仲裁是确定性的：优先级 → 显式标志 → mod id。
[b]三层架构：[/b] - [b]路由[/b]：id → 胜出的物理文件（[method has]、[method resolve]、[method get_data]、[method get_resource]、[method instantiate]）。 - [b]数据库[/b]：内存仓库，可把全部数据 id 预载以实现 O(1) 查询（[method preload_database]、[method get_all]、[method set_data]、[method delete_data]）。 - [b]钩子[/b]：声明式事件点，每个都是命名空间 id（[method add_hook]、[method invoke_hook]、[method emit_hook]、[method check_hook]）。
mod 在 `res://mods-unpacked/` 与 `user://vml/mods/`（zip 安装）下被发现。运行时用 [method enable_mod]/[method disable_mod] 启停；[method install_mod_from_zip] 事务性解压 zip mod。

method.name: is_initialized
method.description:
True once the routing layer and initial mod scan are built.
路由层与初始 mod 扫描完成后为 true。

method.name: has
method.description:
True if `id` resolves to any provider, is reserved, or has a live entry in the content database (unified semantic: routing + reservation + database).
该 `id` 是否解析到某提供者、被预留，或内容数据库中有实时的条目（统一语义：路由 + 预留 + 数据库）。

method.name: has_data
method.description:
True when `id` has a live entry in the in-memory content database (set via [method set_data] or a preload).
内容数据库中有 `id` 的实时条目（经 [method set_data] 或预载写入）时为 true。

method.name: exists
method.description:
Convenience alias of [method has].
[method has] 的便捷别名。

method.name: resolve
method.description:
Physical path of the winning provider for `id` ("" if unknown).
`id` 胜出提供者的物理路径（未知则为 ""）。

method.name: get_data
method.description:
Load by id: .json/.csv parse to Dictionary/Array, everything else returns the Resource. Hits the in-memory database when populated.
按 id 加载：.json/.csv 解析为 Dictionary/Array，其余返回 Resource。数据库已填充时走内存。

method.name: get
method.description:
Convenience alias of [method get_data].
[method get_data] 的便捷别名。

method.name: get_resource
method.description:
Load a Resource by id (scenes, scripts, textures, fonts, audio).
按 id 加载 Resource（场景、脚本、贴图、字体、音频）。

method.name: load
method.description:
Convenience alias of [method get_resource].
[method get_resource] 的便捷别名。

method.name: instantiate
method.description:
Instantiate a PackedScene resolved by id, returning a Node.
按 id 实例化 PackedScene，返回 Node。

method.name: register
method.description:
Explicitly map `id` to `path`; beats implicit providers at equal priority.
显式把 `id` 映射到 `path`；同优先级下胜过隐式提供者。

method.name: register_id
method.description:
Register a direct Variant provider for `id` (no physical file). `priority` defaults to 0 so mod providers (priority > 0) override it. Use [method unregister] to remove.
为 `id` 注册一个直接的 Variant 提供者（无物理文件）。`priority` 默认 0，故 mod 提供者（优先级 > 0）可覆盖它。用 [method unregister] 移除。

method.name: unregister
method.description:
Remove an explicit registration (path- or value-based).
移除一条显式注册（路径或值形式）。

method.name: list_ids
method.description:
All ids as { namespace: PackedStringArray }, optionally filtered by a dotted prefix (e.g. `"game:units."`).
所有 id，格式 { namespace: PackedStringArray }，可按点分隔前缀过滤（如 `"game:units."`）。

method.name: list_namespaces
method.description:
Every content namespace currently indexed.
当前索引的全部内容命名空间。

method.name: list_ids_in_namespace
method.description:
Every full id (`ns:path`) in a namespace, sorted. Empty when the namespace is invalid or absent.
某命名空间下的全部完整 id（`ns:path`），排序。命名空间无效或不存在时为空。

method.name: count_ids
method.description:
Number of ids whose dotted canonical form begins with `prefix` (all ids when empty).
以点分隔规范形式 `prefix` 开头的 id 数量（空则全部）。

method.name: get_id_info
method.description:
Full status of an id: `valid`, `resolved`, `path`, `provider_mod`, `priority`, `explicit`, `preloaded`, `reserved`, `type`, `data_type`.
id 的完整状态：`valid`、`resolved`、`path`、`provider_mod`、`priority`、`explicit`、`preloaded`、`reserved`、`type`、`data_type`。

method.name: get_id_data_type
method.description:
Coarse category of the resolved file: `data`/`scene`/`script`/`image`/`audio`/`font`/`resource`.
解析文件的粗分类：`data`/`scene`/`script`/`image`/`audio`/`font`/`resource`。

method.name: set_id_type
method.description:
Tag an id with a logical type (e.g. "unit", "item") for filtering with [method list_ids_by_type]. Empty type removes the tag.
给 id 打逻辑类型标签（如 "unit"、"item"），配合 [method list_ids_by_type] 过滤。空类型移除标签。

method.name: get_id_type
method.description:
Logical type tag of an id ("" if untagged).
id 的逻辑类型标签（未打标签则为 ""）。

method.name: list_ids_by_type
method.description:
Every id tagged with `type` (dotted ids, sorted).
所有打了 `type` 标签的 id（点分隔、排序）。

method.name: reserve
method.description:
Reserve an id: declares it without a provider so [method has] reports true. Useful for reserving namespaces/names ahead of content.
预留一个 id：声明存在但不带提供者，[method has] 报告 true。用于提前预留命名。

method.name: unreserve
method.description:
Cancel a reservation.
取消一条预留。

method.name: preload_database
method.description:
Preload every data id (or all ids in "all" mode) into the in-memory database.
把全部数据 id（"all" 模式下为全部 id）预载进内存数据库。

method.name: preload_database_async
method.description:
Preload in bounded batches across frames (never blocks); emits [signal preload_progress] then [signal database_loaded].
分批跨帧预载（不阻塞）；发射 [signal preload_progress] 然后 [signal database_loaded]。

method.name: reload_database
method.description:
Clear and re-preload the database per the current mode.
按当前模式清空并重新预载数据库。

method.name: get_all
method.description:
The union of every registry id and every loaded database id, as { canonical_id: value }. Values are resolved lazily via [method get_data] (reserved-only ids without a provider carry no value and are skipped).
所有注册表 id 与已加载数据库 id 的并集，格式 { canonical_id: value }。值经 [method get_data] 惰性解析（无提供者的仅预留 id 不含值、被跳过）。

method.name: set_data
method.description:
Overwrite a database entry in place (emits [signal database_entry_changed]). When `persist` is true, the value is also stored as a project-level `__registry__` value provider (priority 0, so mods override it) and the registry is saved to [method save_registry].
原地改写一条数据库条目（发射 [signal database_entry_changed]）。`persist` 为 true 时，该值还会作为项目级 `__registry__` 值提供者（优先级 0，mod 可覆盖）存储，并保存注册表到 [method save_registry]。

method.name: delete_data
method.description:
Remove a database entry (lookups fall back to the file).
移除一条数据库条目（查询回退到文件）。

method.name: get_database_mode
method.description:
"data" (default), "all", or "off".
"data"（默认）、"all" 或 "off"。

method.name: set_database_mode
method.description:
Switch database mode and reload.
切换数据库模式并重载。

method.name: finish_startup
method.description:
Instantiate every enabled mod's mod_main.gd. Call once from a bootstrap autoload's _ready.
实例化所有已启用 mod 的 mod_main.gd。在 bootstrap autoload 的 _ready 调用一次。

method.name: finish_startup_auto
method.description:
Auto version of [method finish_startup]: call_deferred + retry until the scene tree is ready, so autoload `_ready` has run before mod_mains instantiate. Idempotent. Set `vortarismodloader/auto_finish_startup` to trigger it from the constructor instead of calling it yourself.
[method finish_startup] 的自动版：call_deferred 并在场景树就绪前重试，确保 autoload `_ready` 已运行后才实例化 mod_main。幂等。设置 `vortarismodloader/auto_finish_startup` 可从构造函数自动触发，无需手动调用。

method.name: is_startup_done
method.description:
True once [method finish_startup]/[method finish_startup_auto] has run.
[method finish_startup]/[method finish_startup_auto] 运行过后为 true。

method.name: add_hook
method.description:
Register a Callable on a hook point. Called from a mod_main it is attributed to that mod automatically.
在钩子点上注册一个 Callable。从 mod_main 调用时自动归属该 mod。

method.name: remove_hook
method.description:
Remove one handler.
移除一个处理器。

method.name: invoke_hook
method.description:
Pipeline: each handler receives (current, ...args) and returns the rewritten value; the last value is returned. Handlers run by priority.
管线：每个处理器收到 (current, ...args) 并返回改写后的值；返回最后一个值。处理器按优先级执行。

method.name: invoke_hook_ctx
method.description:
Context pipeline: each handler receives (ctx, ...args) and may return a (possibly modified) Dictionary; the final ctx is returned to the caller. Handler signature `func(ctx: Dictionary, ...args) -> Dictionary`.
上下文管线：每个处理器收到 (ctx, ...args)，可返回（可能修改过的）Dictionary；最终 ctx 返回给调用方。处理器签名 `func(ctx: Dictionary, ...args) -> Dictionary`。

method.name: emit_hook
method.description:
Fire-and-forget broadcast to all handlers.
向所有处理器做即发即忘的广播。

method.name: check_hook
method.description:
Predicate: true when no handler vetoes (any handler returning false short-circuits).
判定：无处理器否决时返回 true（任一返回 false 即短路）。

method.name: register_hook_point
method.description:
Declare a hook point for docs/editor discovery.
声明一个钩子点，供文档/编辑器发现。

method.name: list_hooks
method.description:
Registered hooks as { hook_id: { count, mods } }.
已注册钩子，格式 { hook_id: { count, mods } }。

method.name: list_hook_points
method.description:
Declared hook points as { hook_id: { description, arg_types } }.
已声明钩子点，格式 { hook_id: { description, arg_types } }。

method.name: list_hook_handlers
method.description:
Handlers of a hook in call order (priority desc, mod_id asc) as Array of { mod_id, priority }.
某钩子的处理器，按调用顺序（优先级降序、mod_id 升序）返回 Array[{ mod_id, priority }]。

method.name: list_providers
method.description:
Every provider of an id: { providers: [{ mod_id, path, priority, explicit }], best: int } (best = index of the winning provider, -1 when none).
id 的全部提供者：{ providers: [{ mod_id, path, priority, explicit }], best: int }（best 为胜出提供者下标，无则 -1）。

method.name: get_mod_ids
method.description:
Every discovered mod id (valid or not).
所有发现的 mod id（无论有效与否）。

method.name: get_load_order
method.description:
Dependency-sorted load order of valid mods (base excluded).
有效 mod 的依赖排序加载顺序（不含 base）。

method.name: get_mod_errors
method.description:
Human-readable errors for a mod (missing deps, cycle, bad manifest, validation failures). Note this stays errors-only — use [method get_mod_report] for warnings too.
某个 mod 的可读错误（缺依赖、循环、坏 manifest、校验失败）。注意只含 errors——警告用 [method get_mod_report]。

method.name: validate_mod
method.description:
Validate a mod: manifest completeness, loadable main_script, parseable data JSON, and JSON `"id"` vs path-inferred id cross-check. Returns { valid, errors, warnings, checked }. Run automatically at startup when `vortarismodloader/validate_on_startup` is enabled.
校验一个 mod：manifest 完整性、main_script 可加载、数据 JSON 可解析、JSON `"id"` 与路径推断 id 交叉核对。返回 { valid, errors, warnings, checked }。`vortarismodloader/validate_on_startup` 开启时启动自动运行。

method.name: get_mod_report
method.description:
A mod's stored problems as { errors: PackedStringArray, warnings: PackedStringArray }.
某 mod 的已存问题 { errors: PackedStringArray, warnings: PackedStringArray }。

method.name: get_errors_summary
method.description:
Every problematic mod as { mod_id: { errors, warnings } } (mods with no problems are omitted).
每个有问题 mod：{ mod_id: { errors, warnings } }（无问题的 mod 被省略）。

method.name: get_startup_report
method.description:
Startup aggregate: { broken_mods: PackedStringArray, errors: Array, warnings: Array }.
启动聚合：{ broken_mods: PackedStringArray, errors: Array, warnings: Array }。

method.name: get_mod_path
method.description:
Root directory of a mod ("" if unknown).
某个 mod 的根目录（未知则为 ""）。

method.name: is_mod_enabled
method.description:
True when the mod's content is stacked in the registry.
mod 内容是否已堆叠进注册表。

method.name: is_mod_loaded
method.description:
True when the mod is enabled and its content is active (scanned, or its mod_main instantiated). Reflects enable/disable immediately, including for pure-data mods that have no mod_main.
mod 已启用且其内容处于激活状态（已扫描，或 mod_main 已实例化）时为 true。启用/停用立即反映，包括没有 mod_main 的纯数据 mod。

method.name: get_mod_dependents
method.description:
Enabled mods that depend on `mod_id` (used by the editor's disable-confirmation UI). Disabling a mod cascade-disables its dependents.
依赖 `mod_id` 的已启用 mod（编辑器禁用确认 UI 用）。禁用某 mod 会级联禁用其依赖者。

method.name: enable_mod
method.description:
Activate a mod: stack content, instantiate mod_main, register hooks.
激活一个 mod：堆叠内容、实例化 mod_main、注册钩子。

method.name: disable_mod
method.description:
Deactivate a mod (refused while active mods depend on it).
停用一个 mod（有依赖它的启用 mod 时拒绝）。

method.name: load_mod
method.description:
Runtime load: alias of enable_mod.
运行时加载：enable_mod 的别名。

method.name: unload_mod
method.description:
Runtime unload: alias of disable_mod.
运行时卸载：disable_mod 的别名。

method.name: install_mod_from_zip
method.description:
Transactionally extract a zip mod into the first writable configured mod root (in dev, res://mods) and activate it. Dev-only convenience — distribution uses .pck packs. Returns an Error code.
事务性把 zip mod 解压到第一个可写的已配置 mod 根目录（开发环境为 res://mods）并激活。仅开发用便捷方式——分发使用 .pck 包。返回 Error 码。

method.name: uninstall_mod
method.description:
Remove an installed (user://) mod entirely. Returns an Error code.
彻底移除一个已安装（user://）的 mod。返回 Error 码。

method.name: reload_mod
method.description:
Hot reload one mod in place: drop its hooks/content/database entries, re-scan its files, and re-instantiate its mod_main (no duplicate hooks). Emits [signal mod_reloaded]. Returns false for an unknown mod.
原地热重载一个 mod：移除其钩子/内容/数据库条目、重扫其文件、重新实例化 mod_main（不产生重复钩子）。发射 [signal mod_reloaded]。未知 mod 返回 false。

method.name: get_mod_package_plan
method.description:
Export plan from project settings: { embedded: bool, external: bool, scan_user_mods: bool }.
项目设置导出的打包计划：{ embedded: bool, external: bool, scan_user_mods: bool }。

method.name: set_export_policy
method.description:
Set vortarismodloader/export_mods ("embedded"/"external"/"none") and vortarismodloader/scan_user_mods, persisted to ProjectSettings. Returns false on an unknown mode.
设置 vortarismodloader/export_mods（"embedded"/"external"/"none"）与 vortarismodloader/scan_user_mods，写入 ProjectSettings。未知模式返回 false。

method.name: get_mod_roots
method.description:
Configured mod root directories (vortarismodloader/mod_paths; default ["res://mods", "res://mods-unpacked"]). `.pck` files under a root are mounted read-only at startup.
已配置的 mod 根目录（vortarismodloader/mod_paths；默认 ["res://mods", "res://mods-unpacked"]）。根目录下的 `.pck` 文件会在启动时以只读方式挂载。

method.name: add_mod_root
method.description:
Append a mod root directory and persist it to ProjectSettings. Returns false for an empty path.
追加一个 mod 根目录并写入 ProjectSettings。空路径返回 false。

method.name: remove_mod_root
method.description:
Remove a mod root directory from ProjectSettings. Returns false when absent.
从 ProjectSettings 移除一个 mod 根目录。不存在时返回 false。

method.name: get_error_summary
method.description:
Human-readable startup error summary ("<mod>: <err>" lines, one per error, empty when clean). This is what is printed to the console (and shown in the error dialog) after a scan/finish_startup when `vortarismodloader/show_error_dialogs` is on.
人类可读的启动错误摘要（每行 "<mod>: <err>"，无错误时为空）。扫描/finish_startup 后打印到控制台（`vortarismodloader/show_error_dialogs` 开启时显示在错误弹窗中）的内容。

method.name: get_debug_log
method.description:
Recent advanced-debug lines (gated by `vortarismodloader/debug_output`), each prefixed "[vortarismodloader][dbg]". Empty when the setting is off.
最近的高级调试行（由 `vortarismodloader/debug_output` 门控），每行前缀 "[vortarismodloader][dbg]"。设置关闭时为空。

method.name: clear_debug_log
method.description:
Clear the in-memory advanced-debug log buffer.
清空内存中的高级调试日志缓冲区。

method.name: reload_resources
method.description:
Dev hot reload: re-scan affected mods and refresh their database entries.
开发热重载：重扫受影响的 mod 并刷新其数据库条目。

method.name: get_content_roots
method.description:
Directories the hot-reloader should watch (base layer + enabled mods).
热重载应监视的目录（基础层 + 已启用 mod）。

method.name: start_hot_reload
method.description:
Start a polling hot-reloader node (dev builds / editor).
启动轮询热重载节点（开发构建 / 编辑器）。

method.name: rescan
method.description:
Full re-discovery and rebuild of the routing layer + database.
完整重新发现并重建路由层 + 数据库。

method.name: set_registry_entry
method.description:
Declare an id in the persisted content registry (base-layer route; mods override it). Save with [method save_registry]; loaded automatically at [method finish_startup].
在持久化内容注册表中声明一个 id（基础层路由；mod 可覆盖）。用 [method save_registry] 保存；[method finish_startup] 自动加载。

method.name: get_registry_entry
method.description:
One registry entry as { path, type, description }.
单条注册表条目 { path, type, description }。

method.name: get_registry
method.description:
All registry entries as { id: { path, type, description } }.
全部注册表条目 { id: { path, type, description } }。

method.name: remove_registry_entry
method.description:
Remove a registry entry.
移除一条注册表条目。

method.name: save_registry
method.description:
Persist the registry to JSON. Empty path uses the project-level path (vortarismodloader/registry_path, default res://vml/registry.json); when res:// is read-only (exports) it falls back to user://vml/registry.json. Returns an Error code.
把注册表持久化为 JSON。空路径使用项目级路径（vortarismodloader/registry_path，默认 res://vml/registry.json）；res:// 只读（导出）时回退 user://vml/registry.json。返回 Error 码。

method.name: load_registry
method.description:
Load registry entries from JSON. Empty path uses the project-level path (then falls back to user://vml/registry.json). Returns an Error code.
从 JSON 加载注册表条目。空路径使用项目级路径（随后回退 user://vml/registry.json）。返回 Error 码。

method.name: reroute
method.description:
Temporarily force an id to a path at runtime (highest priority, not persisted). Use [method clear_reroute] to undo.
运行时临时把 id 强制指向某路径（最高优先级、不持久化）。用 [method clear_reroute] 撤销。

method.name: clear_reroute
method.description:
Remove a runtime reroute.
移除一条运行时重路由。

method.name: get_config
method.description:
Read a mod's config from user://vml/configs/<mod_id>.json ({} if unset).
从 user://vml/configs/<mod_id>.json 读取 mod 配置（未设置则 {}）。

method.name: set_config
method.description:
Persist a mod's config.
持久化 mod 配置。

method.name: get_config_schema
method.description:
The mod's declared config_schema (manifest extra.godot.config_schema).
mod 声明的 config_schema（manifest extra.godot.config_schema）。

method.name: build_node
method.description:
Build a Node tree from a Dictionary at id: { type, name, properties, children }.
按 id 处的 Dictionary 构建节点树：{ type, name, properties, children }。

method.name: validate
method.description:
Scan all loaded data for id references and report missing ones: { valid, checked, missing }.
扫描所有已加载数据中的 id 引用并报告缺失：{ valid, checked, missing }。

signal.name: database_loaded
signal.description:
Emitted after a full database preload.
数据库完整预载后发射。

signal.name: preload_progress
signal.description:
Emitted by [method preload_database_async] as batches complete.
[method preload_database_async] 分批完成时发射。

signal.name: database_entry_changed
signal.description:
A database entry was rewritten or removed.
一条数据库条目被改写或移除。

signal.name: mod_loaded
signal.description:
A mod's mod_main was instantiated.
某个 mod 的 mod_main 被实例化。

signal.name: mod_unloaded
signal.description:
A mod was unloaded.
某个 mod 被卸载。

signal.name: mod_enabled
signal.description:
A mod was enabled.
某个 mod 被启用。

signal.name: mod_reloaded
signal.description:
A mod was hot-reloaded in place ([method reload_mod]).
某个 mod 被原地热重载（[method reload_mod]）。

signal.name: mod_disabled
signal.description:
A mod was disabled.
某个 mod 被停用。

signal.name: registry_rebuilt
signal.description:
The routing layer was rebuilt (rescan / hot reload).
路由层被重建（重扫 / 热重载）。
